name: Concurrent Disorders (NSDUH-calibrated)
remarks: Joint MH x SUD profile sampled per NSDUH age group x sex (2024 PUF).

Non-NSDUH assumptions: {"index_delay_days": [0, 365], "second_dx_delay_days": [7, 90], "p_mh_first_in_both": 0.5, "detection_probability_untreated": 1.0, "mh_dx_rule": "AMI + past-year MDE -> Major depressive disorder; AMI without MDE -> Anxiety disorder (assumption: anxiety disorders are the most prevalent non-MDE mental illness in U.S. adults)", "mh_treated_modality": {"ssri_only": 0.4, "psychotherapy_only": 0.35, "both": 0.25}, "aud_treated_naltrexone": 0.5, "oud_treated_buprenorphine": 1.0, "follow_up_visits_if_treated": 3, "follow_up_interval_days": [28, 90], "disorders_remain_active_through_end_of_window": true, "mh_tx_only_for_mh_dx_and_sud_tx_only_for_sud_dx": true}
P(neither / MH only / SUD only / both | NSDUH age group, sex) from the 2024 NSDUH PUF, weighted (ANALWT2_C). MH = AMIPY, SUD = UD5ILALANY.
P(past-year MDE | AMI, SUD status), NSDUH AMDEYR.
AMI + past-year MDE -> Major depressive disorder; AMI without MDE -> Anxiety disorder (assumption: anxiety disorders are the most prevalent non-MDE mental illness in U.S. adults)
P(mild/moderate/serious MI | AMI, SUD status), NSDUH MICATPY.
P(substance pattern | SUD, MH status) from NSDUH IRPYUD5ALC/MRJ/COC/MTH and UD5OPIANY2; patterns with <30 respondents collapsed (see calibration.json).
P(past-year MH treatment | group), NSDUH MHTRTPY2.
P(past-year SUD treatment | group), NSDUH SUTRTPY2.
Assumption: index diagnosis date uniform over the first 12 months of the 24-month window; disorders stay active.
